bound_for_union: For any start satisfying at least one rule and n≥3, one corresponding existing component theorem gives first descent; maximum over the three coverage-expanding filters is 52 ordinary steps. The 23/14 and 31/19 subfilters can yield the sharper 37- and 50-step bounds.
claim_limit: This is a Python exact dynamic-programming count over finite parity words, not a new Lean-checked union theorem. No convergence or novelty claim.
counting_method: Dynamic programming over parity-word prefix odd counts through 32 bits; at each checkpoint, qualifying words are counted once at their first matching filter and removed from the continuation state. Each length-32 parity word corresponds to one residue class modulo 2^32 under the checked parity/residue bijection.
nested_filter_notes: 23/14 is a subset of 24/15: one further accelerated input can add at most one odd.
31/19 is a subset of 32/20 for the same reason.
